rows.grounds: locative of mādana (Madana), fused form as given
fused form nāsti + ato + adhikam; @ marks sandhi fusion

items.question: Which seed-bija is supreme across the three worlds when situated in Madana and Bhaga?
items.inference: The seed in Madana and Bhaga is supreme across the three worlds.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation of mādanasthe and bhage remains unresolved.
items.plain_english: In Madana's place, in Bhaga, the seed; in the three worlds there is nothing beyond it.
